scope: Floating evaluation of a mathematically valid repaired three-step closure proxy on 29 saved physical witnesses, including both allowed q2 selection values (49 fixed evaluations). q±3 are reference-valued. Original AA physical-minus-repaired weights include their full complex planes and selected halfcorrections; the source uses actual height profiles, actual pair plane and fixed collar. This is neither a global bound nor a proof of failure of the actual potential criterion. Length-two shared-edge overlap and singleton runs are not represented by independent two-end corrections.
